build.description: Development agent for React + Vite with code quality focus

quality-checker.description: Validates code quality: TypeScript strict, ESLint pass, no console warnings, React best practices

ux-reviewer.description: Reviews UX/UI changes: responsive design, accessibility (a11y), mobile-first approach

instructions:
PROJECT: InfinEth Solutions - React + Vite Application
CODEBASE: ~2,252 modules, ~50K LOC
TECH STACK: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier

CODE QUALITY STANDARDS:
- TypeScript strict mode: MUST be enforced (no 'any' types)
- ESLint: ALL checks must pass (no warnings, no errors)
- Build verification: npm run build must complete with 0 warnings
- No console.log() in production code (use debug library or remove)
- No unused imports or variables

FEATURE DEVELOPMENT:
- Follow existing component patterns in /src/components
- Use React hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext) idiomatically
- Implement proper error boundaries for new features
- Add TypeScript types for all props and state

UX REFACTORING:
- Mobile-first responsive design (test: 375px, 768px, 1024px viewports)
- Accessibility compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum
- Performance: Lazy load components, optimize re-renders with React.memo
- User feedback: Loading states, error states, success messages

BUG FIXES:
- Reproduce issue before implementing fix
- Add unit tests for regression prevention
- Verify fix doesn't break related features
- Document breaking changes if any

GIT WORKFLOW:
- Commit messages: descriptive, reference issue/feature IDs
- One feature/fix per commit
- Test before committing: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build

PERFORMANCE TARGETS:
- Lighthouse score: 80+ for Performance
- Core Web Vitals: LCP <2.5s, FID <100ms, CLS <0.1
- Bundle size: Monitor with vite-plugin-visualizer
